computed.reason: tfoot: FactsPDF lays the footer out as the last rows of the table-row-group and never repeats it (table-footer-group is not supported)
not modelled: colgroup has no node in the FactsPDF table model (its col children are modelled and match)

hr: Chrome's border is inset (top and left #9a9a9a, bottom and right #eee); FactsPDF paints the same two shades as flat solid edges because border-style inset and outset are not implemented (an author inset fails FPDF1202), so the pixels match apart from the diagonal corner joins
